The '''Throne of the Vanquished Replicator''', also known as '''Replication Throne''', was a unique [[Repulsorlift chair/Legends|repulsorlift chair]] that was created from the wreckage of droid [[XR-53]] during the time of the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR" />

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'' {{1st}}
